card.name: Words saying something is found everywhere
card.fires_on: Quantity words and small linking words in claims that something is widespread, such as almost, all, every, in over, or present in. It fires right before the group the thing spreads across.

modes.label: Universal quantifiers
modes.description: Words like almost, all or every that open a sweeping claim about where something is found.
modes.example: Integrated Circuits are found in<< every>> conceivable electronic device, and control the on

modes.label: Spread and presence verbs
modes.description: Words like present, felt, recorded, or found in, which say how far something reaches.
modes.example: NFκB is acknowledged to be universally<< present>> in every cell type in the body;

modes.label: Before a percentage of coverage
modes.description: The gap or preposition just before a percentage of places or items where something occurs.
modes.example: This one vegetable oil is found in over<< >>50% of all supermarket products

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning everywhere or widespread, such as 遍布, 广泛 and everywhere.
card.plain: It marks a spot in a sentence where the text is about to say something is found almost everywhere.
evidence: Today, sports eyewear can be spotted on<< almost>> anyone who picks up a ball, bat

It has been found<< in>> 93% of Americans tested.
